title: WAL commit-path bundle: widen group-commit window and writer flush batch
configuration_cause: commit_delay=100us with commit_siblings=2 and wal_writer_flush_after=0 leaves the WAL writer flushing per-write; wal_waiting_backends persists at max=1 and sync_average_ms=0.137ms across both replicates, so commit-path syncs are not being coalesced.
mechanism: WAL sync latency and wal_wait are present but small (sync_average_ms 0.137ms, write 0.026ms, host_io stalls 0). The commit path is not the dominant bottleneck (GetUserTweets terminal_capacity_fraction=0.88), yet the mandatory wal_commit_path bundle is actionable. Widen the group-commit collection window (commit_delay 100->500us) and lower the activation threshold (commit_siblings 2->3) so 5 terminals' commits coalesce, and set wal_writer_flush_after 0->256 (2MB) so the writer batches flushes instead of flushing per write. wal_compression stays on (already enabled, non-actionable). This tests whether coalescing syncs reduces wal_waiting_backends and sync time without adding per-commit stall.
query_effect: No plan change expected; commit-path coalescing affects InsertTweet commit latency and WAL wait, not GetUserTweets index path.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase (0.3-1%) if WAL wait is on the critical path for InsertTweet commits; otherwise neutral.
expected_latency_effect: InsertTweet p95 may decrease slightly; GetUserTweets unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Wider group-commit window plus 2MB writer flush batch coalesce fsyncs, lowering average sync time.
Fewer per-commit syncs reduce backends waiting on WAL.
Reduced commit-path queueing frees terminal capacity for completed transactions.

alternatives.statement: WAL wait is incidental; GetUserTweets terminal saturation dominates and TPS stays flat regardless of commit-path tuning.
Widening commit_delay adds fixed per-commit stall that outweighs coalescing, lowering InsertTweet throughput.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Targets the persistent wal_wait anomaly with a coherent group-commit + writer-flush-batch action while leaving the accepted default_statistics_target=300 and cache settings intact; bounded amplitude keeps added commit latency under 1ms.

nodes.label: WAL commit-path bundle: commit_delay 500, commit_siblings 3, wal_writer_flush_after 256
Wider group-commit window plus larger writer flush batch coalesce fsyncs

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Widen from 100us to 500us within safe [0,1000]; 5x window to collect 5 terminals' commits, still under 1ms added latency.
Raise from 2 to 3 within safe [0,20]; with 5 terminals, 3 siblings reliably triggers group commit without over-gating.
Set from 0 to 256 (8kB units) within safe [0,1024]; 2MB flush batch reduces writer sync frequency versus per-write flushing.
